info.name: FinFlow - Commerce Service
info.description: Current customer/merchant APIs. Run folders 00-08 in order with a dedicated test customer. Standalone: start Commerce with local profile, select No Environment in Postman, and use this collection's Variables; user 1/org 10, no Identity/Wallet/token, simulated payments. MySQL/Redis remain normal manual-run dependencies. Integrated: select FinFlow Local environment, set commerceMode=integrated and commercePaymentProvider=wallet (or simulated to match server), then supply accessToken/userId/orgId from Identity and fund Wallet if used. Setup creates unique catalogue/coupon fixtures; Cart clears the test customer's cart. IDs stay Commerce collection-scoped. Fresh keys are generated for new orders; replay retains its key. Expected 409 cases are explicit; health can report 503/DOWN without violating its contract. Only simulated outcome cases are skipped in wallet mode. No automatic production-service startup.
